percentileMethod: Nearest rank. Five bulk observations and 20 routine observations are limited samples; p99 is the observed maximum.
measurementIncidents: One initial previous-week expansion measurement found the row already open from remembered state. The setup was repaired and both affected Driver Pay weeks were rerun in full; invalid setup measurements are excluded here. No financial action failed in the retained matrix.
additionalMeasurementIncidents: Preparing a separate fixture in the same database overlapped one current-week Driver Pay save and held the database-wide financial lock. The entire 20-save action group was rerun in isolation against the same retained fixture; all original samples remain in excludedSamples.
